offers.sn: At IQM, we build world-leading quantum computers for the well-being of humankind. We design systems to tackle computational challenges beyond the practical limits of classical machines. Our work sits at the edge of science and engineering.
offers.rq: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. At least 2 years of experience designing and developing mechanical systems for industrial, scientific, or commercial products. Strong experience with CAD design, preferably Autodesk Inventor and Vault, or comparable CAD and PDM platforms.
